reviews.text:
The workers are so sweet with our pets.
We have a big German Shepherd mix who sheds like crazy and a teeny Dachshund with long silky locks and they both are loved upon and spoiled. Very happy with their "spa" treatments.
All the dogs I've seen there are very social and sweet-natured.
Every time I am there there is 1 or 2 small towels for my 70 lb dog
Nacho loves to visit the Petbar

I swung by with my hound on Sunday. Was looking for a location closer to my home. I was extremely impressed with the location. As doing a self-wash, they supplied the shampoo (3 types), conditioner, separate bays, towels, aprons and than separate areas for blow dryers. They had unique drains as well as inserts that allowed for hound to stand on a comfortable surface.
Perhaps one of the things I liked the most was when done there was nothing to shop and browse which saved me money. Their price is in line with other providers and the first wash free coupon will keep me coming back, Great business and great staff. Very friendly, clean and well organized.
Karina is the best!! Always bathes and grooms my 2 dogs Milo & Milly perfectly 💓 Couldn't recommend more!! …
Great service!

Amazing Service! Groomers are a plus and front reception team is always so welcoming. I have a three legged frenchie and they always go above and beyond to take care of him during his visit! Highly recommend petbar on white oak!
They consistently take wonderful care of our fur babies and do a great job with their baths and grooming.

My neighbor recommended this place as she is a regular. I recently had not so good experiences with my past groomers and was a bit concerned as my dog’s hair is not so easy to handle and she is still a puppy but Karina did magic with my dog! She is an excellent groomer! I’m very grateful. She did exactly what I asked for.
Had 2 dogs in for nail grinding.
We love PetBar! The team is super friendly and they do an amazing job of keeping the pet wash stations clean and sanitized. We are there 2x a month.
I have been bringing my Frenchies here for some years now and wouldn't want to take them anywhere else.
Highly recommend Karina - she does a great job with my pup and is very sweet!
Always a pleasant experience.

Excellent customer service, everyone there is really nice and kind
Gio is always in the front door very friendly and helpful

I had such a great experience with Vee at Petbar Boutique in The Heights! 💗 My puppy’s hair was really knotted and tangled, and Vee did such an amazing job getting everything taken care of. She was so patient and did a beautiful job grooming my puppy. I’m so happy with how my puppy turned out! You can definitely tell Vee cares about the pets she works with. Highly recommend her!
Karina is the best groomer! Very gentle, caring, and listens to her customers requests.❤️  fifi loves her!
Thanks
Always helpful friendly staff

Our monthly visits with Karina at PetBar Heights have been a breath of fresh air!  Prior to being referred to PetBar, we had hopped around from one groomer to the next, never feeling like things were a match. Ginger now walks comfortably in to the salon on grooming day and she demonstrates no concern with me leaving her there in Karina’s excellent care. Not only is Ginger happy when I come to pick her up, but she always looks amazing!  Karina’s professional grooming services are so appreciated and valued!
Thanks Ken

An Amazing Experience with Karina ❤️

I can’t say enough amazing things about Karina and the care she provides every time I bring my dog, Yoshi, in for grooming. From the moment we arrive, she is so kind, patient, and genuinely caring with him. It’s very obvious that she doesn’t just see grooming as a service, she truly cares about the animals she works with and makes sure they feel comfortable, safe, and well taken care of.

Yoshi always looks absolutely amazing when she’s finished with him! The quality of her work is incredible, from his haircut and grooming to all the little details that make such a big difference. He comes home looking clean, fresh, and so handsome every single time. I can tell she takes her time and pays attention to what she’s doing rather than rushing through the appointment.

What I appreciate most is how wonderful she is with Yoshi personally. She has such a gentle and loving approach, and I feel completely comfortable leaving him in her care. Knowing that he is being treated with kindness and respect while he’s there gives me so much peace of mind. You can genuinely tell when someone loves what they do, and Karina is one of those people.

She is also professional, attentive, and consistent with the quality of her service. Every appointment feels like Yoshi is getting the same level of care and attention, and that means so much as a pet owner. I’m very particular about who I trust with him, and Karina has completely earned my trust.

If you’re looking for a groomer who will treat your dog with love while also providing amazing quality grooming, I highly recommend Karina. She is truly incredible at what she does, and I’m so grateful to have found someone who takes such wonderful care of Yoshi. 🐶❤️

Thank you, Karina, for always taking such great care of my baby and making him look his absolute best!

Don’t give them feedback on haircuts. They don’t care about producing good quality work the client asked for. If you’re not happy with the result, instead of fixing it or making it right next time, they just ban your dog. Extremely poor customer service.

I have taken my 13-pound Schnauzer, Romeo, to this groomer for well over a year, paying $100 each time. I continued coming back because I trusted the business and, at one point, specifically requested Karina because I was happy with her work after a terrible experience with a different groomer. Unfortunately, the quality has gone downhill, and after this last appointment, I am DONE.
Romeo was returned to me looking absolutely terrible. His coat was choppy, uneven, excessively short, and full of obvious patches, and his beard was a complete mess—long pieces, short pieces, and nothing even. He barely looked like a Schnauzer.  For $100, this level of grooming is simply unacceptable.
When I complained, I was told they “didn't know where the patches came from.” I'm sorry, but if my dog goes in with an even coat and comes out with patches, where exactly do you think they came from? The proposed solution was for me to drive 40 MINUTES back so they could “even out” the patches and beard. In other words, take even more hair off to try to correct a haircut that was already cut far too short.
This isn't even the first issue I've overlooked. On a previous visit, Romeo's ear was clipped. I didn't make a huge issue out of it because I wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt. But there comes a point when enough is enough.
I was also asked to drop Romeo off earlier than his scheduled appointment time this last visit. I agreed, but after seeing the finished product, I cannot help but question whether his grooming was rushed or simply not given the attention it should have received.
I am not paying $100 to repeatedly receive a dog that looks like someone was practicing with clippers. The price is not the issue—the lack of quality, consistency, and accountability is.
Romeo will NEVER be returning here, and I absolutely will NOT recommend this groomer to anyone. If you are considering bringing your dog here, I strongly suggest you look elsewhere. There are groomers who charge premium prices and actually deliver premium work. This was not that experience.
Save your money and save your dog the unnecessary stress. Find another groomer.
Clean, great product, and equipment makes it easy to wash my 80 lb lab.

Petbar Boutique was highly recommended by a new acquaintance! Our two small Cavaliers were badly in need of grooming. Karina was attentive to my requests and our pups looked spectacular when picked up. Certain they also felt better! We were immensely pleased and will choose Petbar in the Heights for our pet’s future baths and grooming!

Grey has been grooming my Golden Retriever, Jolie, for many years, and I couldn't have asked for better care. As Jolie got older, Grey always treated her with exceptional compassion, patience, and kindness. She understood the special needs of a senior dog and always made sure Jolie was comfortable throughout every visit.
Grey is highly professional and consistently provides outstanding, high-quality grooming. I always knew Jolie was in caring and capable hands.
The entire team at Pet Bar has been incredibly kind, supportive, and loving toward Jolie throughout her life, right through her senior years. Their genuine care meant so much to me. I highly recommend Grey and the entire Pet Bar team to anyone looking for excellent grooming services and people who truly care about the well-being of your dog. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my sweet Jolie over the years. I will always be grateful.
I loved it! Veronica was very kind and sweet with my baby🐶🩷 …
Thanks Barson
The people are so nice I bring my super big and fluffy dog and it is a hair tornado in there and they're so nice and self wash is super well priced with good products
Very helpful and great service
not a review type of person BUT the staff there today around 1ish lady with the glasses and young man working the front too AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING this is a place i WILL put my money into.

I took my pet in with Vee
I can't recommend this groomer enough! They always do an amazing job, and my pet comes home looking and smelling great every time. The staff is friendly, professional, and truly cares about the pets they work with. It's such a relief knowing my pet is in such good hands. Thank you for the excellent care!

Thank you for taking care of my babies!

Love this place! The price is great, always clean, plenty of towels and aprons for the self-service dog wash area. Parking can be difficult and it can get busy on the weekends, so we tend to go on weekdays.

Great customer service and my Pomeranian puppy was treated amazingly. They also have self service wash stations with 3 different soaps and conditioners along with drying stations. Can’t recommend this place enough for grooming and general pet maintenance.

Called Petbar when I first got my dog and he was covered in burrs from the farm he was living on. He’s scared of everything and everyone. They suggested their groomer, Karina, and OMG we love her!!! My fearful dog even gets excited when he knows we’re seeing Karina!!! Couldn’t be happier, highly suggest!!

Karina is hands down the best groomer for my mini Goldendoodle! I trust her completely when it comes to his haircuts because she always leaves him looking absolutely perfect. She pays attention to detail and follows my inspiration pictures every single time.
If you have a doodle, you know not everyone knows how to groom them properly, which is why I highly recommend Karina. She truly understands doodle coats and always gives him the cutest cuts. Another huge plus is how efficient she is—he’s always in and out quickly, which makes the whole experience stress-free for both of us.
We love Karina and wouldn’t trust anyone else with our boy!
We are so happy! This is the best grooming service she has had! Thank y’all so much!

I want to thank Grey for taking care of Oakley these past 3 years. Every detail she does with love and dedication. Shes very professional and I always feel at home knowing our baby is in good hands. The front desk staff are always very attentive to give the best experience in Spanish and English! Highly recommend Grey and Petbar Boutique-The Heights!
took my chihuahua chencho recently and yall did amazing :) the guy at the front desk Geo made me feel so welcomed he was super helpful and kind
Karina has been the best groomer for my pup. I’m so happy with her service!
Always had a great experience there for my golden doodle dog Millie. Karina does a great job with grooming, is the only place I go to now. Thank you Karina!

I would give it 0 stars if I could they nearly killed my dog complete negligence not educated on their jobs at all DO not trust your fur baby’s well being with this groomer my dog was about 5 minutes away from dying. My dog suffered a heat stroke and nearly collapsed lungs at the hands of these guys. Did not receive an apology or even a refund after confronting the groomer about what my dog had experienced, I was literally in the car crying holding my dog because I thought he was going to die. Total animal ABUSERS I am traumatized from the state my dog was returned to me, his wheezing and blood shot RED eyes is imprinted in my brain and just keeps replaying I have videos if I was able to post videos to this review I would

Absolute nightmare left my English bulldog here for a bath came back and he was wheezing and about to pass out apparently they can’t give him water but they took him for a walk in 100 degree heat but when I went back inside to complain the guy behind the counter argued “they take good care of dogs because they left him in front of a fan but they’re not allowed to give them water” I really do feel my dog was about to die when I picked him up will not trust this place at all with him again

Karina is amazing! She’s been grooming my XL Goldendoodle for almost 2 years now, and he always comes out looking perfect. My dog is usually terrified of going to the groomer, but he absolutely loves her. She’s so patient and great with him, and she gets him done much faster than anywhere else we’ve been. I recommend her to all of my friends and neighbors!

I love coming to the Petbar located in the Heights. We’ve been taking our two shihtzus with Karina for over two years now.  Karina does impeccable work and is always very attentive and caring with our little ones and their needs. We could not recommend her enough.

Karina, thank you so much for always taking such great care of Zeus! 🐻‍❄️
His grooming, bath, and teeth brushing always come out perfect, and he genuinely loves going with you. It gives me a lot of peace knowing he’s in such caring and professional hands. Zeus always comes back looking fluffy, clean, happy, and smelling amazing. Highly recommend Karina to anyone looking for someone trustworthy who truly loves dogs!
Thanks for your feedback Lourdes!
Vee did an amazing job. She listened to my needs and my Kuma came out lovely. Bailee was clean and happy.
Petbar was very professional and attentive. Groomer Vee was attentive and did a great job bathing and grooming. No itching on dog as occurred at other groomers.
It’s a what I asked for vs what I got situation. My pup looks a mess,  we won’t be back EVER.
Excellent service. Dina reassured me that my little one was in good hands.

Got my Giant Schnauzer, Oshun, groomed here today by Vee, and I truly could not be happier with the experience! This place is absolutely amazing, and Vee was exceptional from start to finish.

She took the time to properly introduce herself to Oshun, who can sometimes be a little wary of strangers, and immediately made both of us feel comfortable. She was extremely communicative, honest, and realistic about what to expect due to the mats Oshun had, which I really appreciated.

What stood out the most was the level of care and attention she gave throughout the entire process. You can genuinely tell that every part of the groom was done thoughtfully and with patience. Oshun came out looking like an entirely different dog, and I am beyond pleased with the results!

They also spent much more time on the groom than originally estimated, which honestly meant a lot to me because it showed how attentive and thorough they were rather than rushing through the appointment.

I truly cannot say enough good things about this experience. Vee was absolutely incredible, and I highly, highly recommend this business to anyone looking for a groomer who genuinely cares about both the dogs and the quality of their work!
Corinna is incredible and our dog always look great!
So obsessed with how my dog’s grooming turned out. Vee did an amazing job! She was super sweet and accommodating as well.

I had an absolutely wonderful experience bringing my dog, Cici, to this grooming salon! The groomer — Bee, who took care of Cici was incredibly kind, always with a bright smile. Despite the fact that Cici was very dirty from all the recent rain, the groomer cleaned her so thoroughly—she looked spotless! The haircut was beyond perfect; Cici now looks like a teddy bear! I’m so grateful and highly recommend this place—such a fantastic groomer and service!

I have been a part of the membership bath program for over a year now and I can honestly say it is the best gift you can give yourself! It is so nice to be able to take your dog every week or every other week and they come back smelling so good, they are perfectly brushed out and soft. The staff at this location are also so nice! I feel very comfortable leaving my dog there. Whenever I drop my dog off, she doesn’t even look back at me. She is very comfortable there and never seems stressed or anxious when I go pick her up. My dog is 14 years old and I usually am very stressed out when I have to leave her somewhere, especially for a grooming or bath, but not at pet bar. I can tell from my dog’s demeanor that she is well cared for. I really appreciate that especially with a senior dog who has a hard time standing for long periods.
Thanks Kubiak

This by far is the best experience I have had with my 3 dogs at any pet grooming facility!!  All the employees are very nice, the prices are phenomenal. I even got memberships  for my 🐶 puppies.   Very nice clean PETBAR with great hours and 5 star service! You just gained a loyal client with 3 puppies!  If you are in the area you must go you and your puppy will love it!
Their self wash stations are very convenient. I was expecting less because of the low price but everything was great and provided all you need to groom! Definitely recommend
Shot out to Mandy for great customer service 🐕‍🦺 and tolerance of Mulatta Birthday bad behavior. Thank you for going above and beyond to accommodate my family and I. Greatly appreciated 👍🏾
I love this place so much and so do my dogs! They get along with the wonderful staff and although it just opened this is for sure the spot I’m taking my dogs from now on! 😉. …

Karina did a wonderful job with my Miko! She is thorough and makes sure your comments are taken care of! The facility is clean and you can tell everyone cares for the dogs. Miko was so happy after I picked her up and she looks even cuter than usual! Thank you! I will be back

The two females (i did not get their names) who worked the front desk today were awesome! I am from out of town & it was my first time here. They guided me through what I need to do & how to give my pet the best wash & dry self service :)
Thanks Marcka
Love this place! Thank you for grooming this abandoned pup! Beautiful groom!!!
Thanks Jaime for your feedback
They were incredibly helpful and especially patient. I will certainly be back!!

I was hoping this Heights pet salon would be better than the other 2 local ones I’ve used but that was not the case. My first and last time taking my dog here. I dropped my Yorkie off at 9:25a for a 9:30a appointment, met the groomer, Carolina, told her about a bad experience with another salon that had him in a cage for hours because they were “running late.”  This was worse!  I had to call them at 2:00p because I had not heard from them. Turns out he had been done hours before and he was just waiting in a cage. Supposedly, the groomer didn’t notify the front desk so they didn’t contact me. Completely unacceptable.
We were a walk-in and they immediately took care of BigSam.  They did a GREAT job of bathing and cleaning him up.   Thanxs!!!
Amazing staff and a clean place to bring your doggie.

They're the worst. Don't be fooled by the reviews; they're not professional. They made me drive 40 minutes and in the end, they told me they weren't going to see me and that I should make another appointment. They're not professionals; they're charlatans and liars.

I've only used PetBar once and was initially pleased with my dog’s haircut.  Unfortunately, there was a serious issue with the gland expression not being done correctly that overshadowed the experience.

After the appointment, my dog was visibly uncomfortable, rubbing his bottom on the ground and constantly sitting, even on walks. It was sad, as this behavior was completely new and did not exist prior to the grooming. I called the following day and was advised to monitor the situation. When it continued, I shared photos and returned to the shop.

At that visit, a more experienced groomer re-expressed his glands and confirmed they had not been properly emptied during the original appointment. While I appreciated the follow-up care, this issue caused my dog unnecessary discomfort and required additional time and effort on my part. I reached out to management and did not receive a response, which is disappointing.

I’m sharing this review to highlight the importance of groomers properly executing services or not offering it when inexperienced. Also the poor customer service. To not hear back is insulting. It is fair to say I will not be returning.
Thanks for your feedback Yaquelyn!
My boy Grover ❤️ got a new haircut
Terrific job. Terrific prices.

This place is amazing! The staff was very helpful and polite.
They offer cleaning services.
And even self-service cleanings which is amazing and I've never seen that anywhere else before.
The self-service fee is $25 before tax.  Which I believe is a really fair rate Considering the equipment (washing tubs and air drying rooms) and multiple types of shampoo including tear-free for the face.
They showed me how their system operates and gave me some good recommendations on tips to make it easier.
My dog is a big Fluffy husky and it takes a LONG TIME, but they have no time limit in their policy so I didn't feel rushed and gave my boy the cleaning he deserves.
I WILL RETURN AGAIN💚

Karina did my Shih Tzu, Ponzu’s, first ever grooming as a puppy and we’ve been going to her ever since! She does an amazing job and always accommodates my requests. I know that Ponzu is in good hands when he is with Karina. If you are in need of a new groomer, look no further!

I loved this place! I hadn't found anywhere else because everyone told me no, just because my dog ​​had a few knots in her fur. But they took care of her without hesitation. They gave her a complete grooming service, including a haircut, nail trim, ear cleaning, and even a flea bath (which is optional). They treated my dog ​​with so much love and are very professional. I loved it, so this will definitely be the place I always take her.

Thank you for being extra loving and kind to me and my pup. The young man at the desk answered all my questions so kindly and patiently. He sent me pics throughout the appointment to help ease my mind. I was so nervous but they told me my dog did great. They even put his new collar and harness on him for when I picked him up. The kindness of the people we worked with really touched my heart.

Karina at PetBar is a dog whisperer! Our chow chow has been getting groomed with Karina for over a year and she always does the BEST job. Our dog doesn’t love going to the groomer (can you blame him?!) but Karina makes it tolerable and relatively painless. Highly recommend!

The place is very well set up; they offer everything you could possibly need to bathe your pet. The staff is super friendly, explaining everything in detail and taking the time to attend to customers. In my case, my dog ​​was scared by the water pressure and the force of the dryer. They offer ear covers that help tolerate the noise, but in general, the dog should be used to it. You can hear a lot of anxious dogs, which makes the place a bit noisy. I think it will depend on each individual case. Otherwise, it's clean and well-run.

I am always nervous taking my fur baby to a new groomer because you never know how it will go. My pup is a German Shepherd mix with long hair, and getting a short summer cut to actually look GOOD has always been a challenge. He has had more than a few bad haircuts in the past, but PetBar Boutique completely exceeded my expectations.

They were responsive on the phone, very welcoming when we arrived, and they even gave me a tour so I could see how everything works. I loved the concept, the cleanliness, and the way they truly care for the animals. His haircut came out perfect, they did a great job on his nail trim, he smells amazing, and he looks adorable.

The best part is how happy he has been all day. I can tell he feels good. Usually after grooming he is a bit mopy because he is scared or stressed, but that was not the case here. I genuinely think he enjoyed his experience and feels better.

Another thing I love is that they have everything you could possibly need for self grooming too. It is convenient, clean, and well organized, which makes it even better.

I will absolutely be coming back and recommending PetBar Boutique Houston to all of my friends. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish.
Thanks AF

I’ve been taking my dog Rocco to Karina for the past 3 years, and she’s been absolutely amazing every single time. She treats him like her own, and it really shows in how comfortable and happy he is after every grooming session. Rocco always comes back looking fresh, smelling great, and perfectly trimmed. Karina is professional, caring, and truly talented at what she does.

We had the best experience going to PetBar for the first time. I was not sure who to book with for a groomer and after reading glowing reviews, we booked Grey. She was wonderful! Harley’s hair looks perfect and I can tell she was so sweet with our girl. I also liked how there are cameras all over, we could see our puppy waiting in her space in the back when we walked in. She had a ton of space and looked very comfortable. Thank you! See you next time
Loved Petbar!
This is an amazing place to bring your Dog! The staff is well trained to handle difficult Dogs like mine. I really appreciate the help, my boy is looking beautiful!
Amazing service! My Max loves Carolina, she always does a great job!
Thanks for your feedback

The staff was very friendly and accommodating. I called ahead to make sure I could bring my sweetie in for a nail trim and asked how long the wait was. They relayed that they would be able to trim when I arrived and they did just that. My sweet baby was taken care of and they allowed me to be with her but there was no need. Will be back next time. Highly recommended.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
If I could give you 10 stars, I would 😊
I drove almost 40 minutes just to try you out for the first time, and my experience was wonderful.

My five-year-old Maltipoo, Jelly Bean, had her grooming done by Karina, and I highly recommend her! I was looking for a place and a groomer who worked quickly and, above all, was loving and careful with my dog, as she's super nervous and has luxating kneecaps in both hind legs. We found exactly what we were looking for and much more! 😍 From Karina to all the employees I saw, everyone was very kind and did their job with a smile. The place is very nice and clean. Because it's far from my house, I had to stay inside waiting for my dog, and I saw many happy clients arriving to drop off their dogs, as well as many others arriving to pick them up. Everyone, both owners and dogs, left happy. I asked if Jelly Bean had peed, and to my surprise, they said no! I got a lump in my throat, but I held back the tears. With her previous groomer, she would always wet herself from nerves when we arrived, even though they hadn't touched her yet 💔. What really caught my attention was going home, and Jelly Bean was relaxed, calm, happy, and sleeping the whole way 🥲🥲🥲 (I had to wipe away tears of happiness at the peace I saw in my four-legged baby). With her previous groomer, she would come out so stressed after sometimes being there for 5 hours or more, that she would be restless and panting the whole way home 😥. Today, Karina had her ready in an hour and a half 😍🙌❤️

You definitely gained a client for life today. It was worth every mile traveled in those almost 40 minutes to get to you. All I can say is, THANK YOU 🙏🏻❤️😊
Thanks Victor 👍 …

I really wanted to love this place because the first time I came, they did such a wonderful job with my dog. That’s why I decided to come back and even paid nearly $200 expecting the same level of care. Unfortunately, this time was very disappointing.

When I got home, my dog was shedding everywhere—almost worse than before the appointment. It honestly felt like nothing had been done beyond just giving a bath. My significant other reached out to the spa about our concerns, but the only solution they offered was to pay again for another bath and offer to deshed again which the bath would have been another $85.

Will not be coming back here again. See photos for reference
They’re so kind and did great. I’m so grateful for their kindness with my difficult dog. Thank you guys so much
Thanks Trent
FIRST-TIME TAKING MY DOG AND SHE HAS RAZOR CUTS
Such a cute place! I chose to bathe my dog myself, but they will do it for you, if you’d rather. The place was clean, the guy was helpful to explain how it works, the experience was lovely.
Thanks Savannah!

Here’s your updated review with that addition:

⸻
My dog, Honey, has anxiety, so I’m always careful about where I take her. Petbar has been amazing! All the staff are so kind and sweet, and they clearly know how to work with anxious dogs. Honey came back smelling so good, clean, and with much less stress than before. I’m so happy to have found a place where she feels comfortable and cared for. Highly recommend!
